issues.description: The problem statement and template expect a public Farm method named singFarmSong() that prints the song (see UML and the song description). The solution implementation, however, defines this public method as playFarmSong() (solution_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java:59-64) while the template provides a singFarmSong() stub (template_repository/src/de/tum/cit/ase/Farm.java:9-11) and the problem statement (problem_statement.md) documents singFarmSong(). This name/signature mismatch means the solution does not match the API students will see in the template/problem: code examples (Main) in both template and solution refer to singFarmSong(), so uncommenting those lines against the provided solution would cause a compile error or confusion about which method to implement/call. This is an unintentional structural inconsistency that will block or confuse students trying to follow the specified API.
issues.suggested_fix: Align the public API name across all artifacts. Either (A) rename the solution's playFarmSong() method to singFarmSong() (and keep the existing singFarmSongVerse helper), or (B) change the template/problem to require/play a method called playFarmSong() instead. Also update any example calls in Main to use the finalized method name. Preferred fix: rename playFarmSong() in the solution to singFarmSong() so it matches the UML, template stub, and problem description.

issues.description: The problem statement and template define/require a Farm method named singFarmSong(), but the solution implementation provides a method named playFarmSong() instead. This names the same conceptual operation (play/sing the farm song) with different identifiers across artifacts, which can confuse students mapping the requirement to the final code and may cause tests or example usages expecting singFarmSong() to fail or appear inconsistent.
issues.suggested_fix: Align the solution with the problem/template naming. Rename the solution method playFarmSong() to singFarmSong(), or add a public singFarmSong() wrapper that delegates to playFarmSong(), so the same conceptual operation uses the same identifier across all artifacts.
